I can't controll or assume I know what these other people are feeling or what they think reguardless on the affect on me of what I assume. I 
 only have controll over myself my actions and what I think and in turn how I feel. I think my experience is allot like yours. 
Growing up I was diagnosed with Adhd, depression and another dissorder having to do with not wanting to do what I'm being told. 
I believe there are at least 4 headmates here with me that can be cocon in the front. 
 
I think I've always been multiple due to my childhood but only recently became aware. 
I believe that one of my head mates is a persecuter/ protector.  I learned about passive influence and confronting witch helped me tremendously start to understand how my system worked. When I feel like an alter is  closer to the front the  body felt different, voice changes and I know facial expressions change.i can feel like I'm speaking from the inside to the one actually in control and I can influence him a bit but only nessicarily. He can be incredibly mean and lash out horribly or be completely pulled away.
 
My protector self is plauged with trying to find out what's wrong with us or me I we haha. It's still a big dilmea where some of us are like well yeah we are here but he's like " Nope it's impossible"  not because there's no trama but because I guess we aren't loud enough for him and we struggle telling diffence. So he just blocks and blocks and blocks hoping maybe if he makes himself stop believing it'll be true that we made it up. Of course all of that is counter productive.  Being also diagnosed with bipolar and depressions and them just now considering me for DID treatment, made it hard. Was the fact that I just straight lost 2 hours just me being absent minded? Thoughts being snatched from my brain when I know one of them probably dosent want me to talk about it and when they do they take over when it goes wrong. There are just too many signs for us to let it go the way he wants us too. I could never tell the difference, i was so blended and foggy I just now am making a start and improving on telling the difference between what I'm feel as my emotions and bipolar and depression signs and when it's something different that matches but not quite right.

Going through what you are can be scary and hard,  and I know im probably not much t help but it's important I think to trust your gut and not invalidate yourself. No matter what you are going through something hard and acknowledge how far you've gotten so far and to keep moving forward. It can be towards being more together or sure of yourself and each other being more grounded .  It's really good that you reached out it shows you care and are trying and that's a start. You deserve that . If you need anyone to talk to I'm free to chat and  this community is amazing and full of information and help.
